    green_count = sum(1 for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N')
    collected += 1
    print(f"Clicked ({r}, {c}): green={green_count}, state={state}")
    if state == 'GAME_OVER':
        print(f"Game over after {collected} clicks")
        break

print(f"\nTotal collected this round: {collected}")
</parameter>
</function>
